Name: Trinket Drop Chance Config
Author: XanCreations
Description:
[center][color=#ffd966][size=5][b]﻿Trinket Drop Chance Config[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#f1c232][size=2][i]By XanCreations[/i][/size][/color]


[b]Version:[/b] 1.0.3
[b]Compatibility:[/b] Stardew Valley [1.6+][/center]


[b][color=#ffd966][u]Description:[/u][/color][/b]
Have you ever felt like you got all the trinkets and now they just clutter up your inventory whenever you kill monsters or smash crates? Or how about when there are mods (like those that use TrinketTinker framework) that give the player an early trinket slot and all of a sudden you're getting trinkets too early in the game?
No worries! Just set this config to "0" and you won't get any at all, or just make it a lower number so they drop less.
Or maybe you just really like getting trinkets and wouldn't mind giving yourself a boost in trinket chance. That's fine, just turn it up to 200% or maybe even higher? The choice is yours!

[b][color=#ffd966][u]Current Features:[/u][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Spawn Chance:[/b] You can make this "0" for no spawns at all, or turn it all the way up to 1000 for 1000% increase in spawn chance (this is currently the max).
[*][b]Disable Vanilla Trinket Drops:[/b] If you tick this box, you won't get any vanilla trinkets dropping at all.
[*][b]Disable Duplicate Trinket Drops:[/b] If you tick this box, you will get ONE copy of a specific trinket, and then it will not drop again after that. If you untick it, you will start getting duplicate drops again. One extra caveat of ticking this box, is that you are making trinkets a little rarer to get each time you get one. For example, if there are 10 trinkets to find in total, after you find 5, you'll notice it'll be twice as hard to find the remaining 5. When I tested this, it took me a while to find the final trinket in my list. I personally like this system as it makes trinkets more rare. But I purposefully increased the maximum spawn chance on my config so you can increase this if you want to alleviate that a little.
[/list]

[b][color=#ffd966][u]Installation:[/u][/color][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] if you haven't already.
[*]Extract TrinketChanceConfig into your mods folder. It will end up being:
[code]﻿﻿StardewValley\Mods\TrinketChanceConfig
[/code]
[*]Launch via SMAPI at least once to generate the config.
[/list]

[color=#ffd966][b][u]Do I need to reload each time?[/u][/b]
[/color]No, this config works in real-time. Set it to the value you like as you play.


[b][color=#ffd966][u]Compatibility:[/u][/color][/b]
This should be compatible with other mods.
It should work in multiplayer and split-screen. I haven't had any issues when testing it myself.


I initially came up with this idea because when I created an early trinket slot on my mod, I didn't consider that players would get trinket drops really early in the game. The purpose was to create a config to disable trinkets, but it was better to just make a separate GMCM config that gives players more freedom over the drop chance.
If you encounter any issues or have any questions please post a comment. Thanks!
